rules: Every runtime module has exactly one bounded-context owner.
Domain/application code cannot depend on DOM, browser storage, network, wall clock, or ambient RNG.
Domain compatibility globals are explicitly allowlisted.
ECS component payloads are behavior-free plain data.
Imported JSON cannot register executable systems, commands, callbacks, modules, or source code.
Bundled 3D assets are immutable data manifests; model geometry and rig sockets do not live in renderer branches.
architecture.developerToolbox: DEVELOPER-TOOLBOX.md: typed commands, bounded fixed steps, detached readouts, reviewed story activation and single-active context/host leases

verification.rule: Evidence is valid only when the complete gate freshly passes against unchanged inputs matching sourceSha256 and standalone htmlSha256. Documentation-only edits do not change this input digest.

current.rule: The previous complete gate and unchanged runtime proof do not replace the new final-source gate.

deliberateDebt: The global LW facade and process-global content registries remain compatibility surfaces for the self-contained browser artifact.
ECS structural changes are atomic; domain value transactions retain explicit preflight/rollback responsibility.
Imported data uses compiled supported capabilities. Custom renderer and animation executors are trusted compiled extensions.
Not every presentation module has complete strict semantic TypeScript checking; all inventoried domain/application debt is closed.
limits: Hardware WebGL/GPU behavior is not verified by headless browser tests.
Physical touch devices, screen readers, localization, human usability, balance, and enjoyment require separate validation.
Native Motorsport Manager Godot gameplay is outside the Littlewild implementation scope, though repository CI may still run native regression gates.
